offer.requirements:
• Strong motivation to switch into Elixir programming after delivering projects in any other backend language.

  • Experience in building scalable applications.

  • Solid knowledge of databases (preferably PostgreSQL).

  • General knowledge of ElasticSearch.

  • Good command of Polish and intermediate English. We speak in dev teams mainly in Polish, while documentation and communication with other branches are held in English.

  • Putting stress on quality and error-free solutions.
offer.title: Frontend Developer Germany
offer.locations_question: What is your preferred work location?
offer.description:
Recruitee develops innovative SaaS Recruitment Software to help companies hire better, and we are on a mission to make great hiring accessible to all. 🤲

We’re headquartered in Amsterdam with offices in Poznan, Wroclaw, and Paris! Our international team just crossed 180 happy employees of 25 nationalities. We are proud of our humble beginnings, which have now transformed into rocketing growth with over 4,500 much-loved customers worldwide, and we are not stopping here!

Due to the constant growth of our product and solving challenges in the application's codebase and scalability, we want to hire fresh blood for backend development. Whatever technology you come from—RoR, Python, Golang, PHP, or Java—you might be our next Programmer working in the most appealing technology on the market: Elixir!

We have a few experienced teams where you would grow as a Backend Developer: Core, Foundation, or Careers. 🚀

Our backend and main API are written in Elixir (REST + WebSockets), and we leverage the best available in the Phoenix framework and OTP. The whole project includes a few separate applications driven by microservices. Other services are developed in Ruby on Rails and Python/Flask.
